$comment: Coywolf's decisions per slug (successor of coywolf-pack src/robots/data/verified.json). token pins the robots.txt token; verification pins status/evidence/sourceUrl/verifiedAt/note (verified, or unverified with evidence none); purpose records what the bot is for, with its source; category overrides Radar's; exclude drops a bot (with a reason); aliases, previousTokens, delisted and reviewDecisions as named. Sorted by slug.
